findings.title: Module artifactId/name/description contradict each other about test-only status
findings.body: The pom sets artifactId to `keycloak-authz-client-tests` but the <name> is 'Keycloak Authz: Client API' and the <description> says 'This module is supposed to be used just in the Keycloak repository for the testsuite. It is NOT supposed to be used by the 3rd party applications. For the use by 3rd party applications, please use `org.keycloak:keycloak-authz-client` module.' The artifactId says 'tests' while the name/description describe the client API itself, and the newly added META-INF/services/org.keycloak.common.crypto.CryptoProvider file means this artifact now ships a ServiceLoader registration that will be picked up by any JVM that has this jar on the classpath — including, per the description, contexts where it is not supposed to be used. If this module is truly test-only it should not be producing a service registration consumed at runtime; if it is the real client artifact, the artifactId/name are wrong. Either way the packaging metadata is inconsistent with the new runtime-visible service file.
